assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: game main menu concept image, one finished 16:9 desktop screen.
Primary request: redesign HSMultiplayer as a minimalist near-modern cooperative 2D adventure game. The user explicitly wants a simple modern/near-modern aesthetic and a base/workshop feel. This is a UI design screenshot, not a character illustration.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet practical base studio/workshop, slightly elevated diagonal game camera. A well-organized pale-gray workbench with small ordinary tools, steel storage shelves, a desk computer, a plant beside a broad daylight window, concrete/powder-coated metal/wood surfaces. Moderate stylized game illustration, simple readable shapes, restrained detail, slightly warm daylight. The usable room footprint is an irregular union of three connected hexagonal floor modules, open joins inside, subtle hexagonal floor paving. The workshop occupies the right two thirds, leaves clean negative space at left for the menu. No central hero or warrior portrait.
UI design: exceptionally clean flat graphic UI, comfortable spacing, crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, graphite and warm off-white with one muted blue-green accent. No ornate frames, no decorative corners, no holographic panels. The UI feels like a thoughtful desktop indie game, not a corporate dashboard. The workshop has ordinary workshop doors and practical furniture, no magical gateway.
Composition: title at upper left-middle, three large but light vertical menu buttons below. First button pale solid blue-green with dark text, other two subtly translucent neutral rectangles with a fine border. Everything optically aligned, abundant breathing room. Render only one screen, not a montage or presentation board.
Text (verbatim): title "HSMultiplayer"; exactly THREE buttons "开始游戏", "设置", "退出". Small noninteractive version "0.6.0" in a lower corner. No other visible text.
Constraints: main menu has exactly those three buttons, no additional language button, social panel, account, store, continue, multiplayer button or credits button. Language and keybind controls belong inside Settings. Chinese glyphs must be accurate and sharp. Full bleed 16:9 game image, no browser frame, no device mockup, no labels outside screen.
Avoid: Western fantasy, castles, gothic arches, stone ruins, gold or brass ornament, runes, magic portals, swords as decoration, medieval furniture, steampunk gears, spaceship interior, cyberpunk neon, futuristic holograms, excessive gradients, character showcase.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: personal preparation hall UI design, one finished full-screen 16:9 game screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for clean typography, restrained blue-green/graphite/cream palette, modern base/workshop furniture and daylight. Do not keep its main-menu layout or view.
Primary request: a walkable preparation base/workshop for HSMultiplayer, minimalist near-modern art direction. Show the actual 2D game's elevated diagonal/isometric-like scene, not a web dashboard, not character art. Clear modest stylized game illustration rather than a photo. The player is a very small neutral expedition avatar in the space.
Spatial composition: an irregular floor plan formed by THREE JOINED large hexagonal modules: center workshop, upper-left storage bay, upper-right communications bay. Their joins are fully open with visible floor continuity; all modules form ONE shared hall. The external outline should visibly have angled shoulders and an irregular combined-hex footprint, not one regular hexagon and not a rectangular office. Subtle small hexagonal floor grid. Outer cutaway walls low enough not to hide the scene, warm off-white concrete, gray steel, wood workbench tops, soft daylight and a few practical desk lights. Space feels like a working base and creative studio, no extravagant equipment.
Arrange SIX readable walk-up interactive devices around the perimeter, each with a small monochrome symbol above it but NO permanent name label: an ordinary deployment door with a solo/person symbol (single-player launch); a compact room-settings console with sliders symbol; a study/upgrade bench with branching-tree symbol; a communications computer with plus/network symbol (host); a separate radio/computer with network arrow symbol (join); a steel warehouse locker/storage shelf with crate symbol. Player can walk freely between them. Avoid portals.
Overlay UI: small "个人大厅" title upper-left, underneath "玩家 · 战士机体"; upper-right point symbol with "12" and small "局外点数", plus a discrete gear icon with Esc. Flat graphite semi-opaque panels, thin functional borders, rounded corners subtle, excellent spacing, Chinese sans-serif. UI is concise and practical.
A normal draggable "房间设置" window sits at the right edge, width about 24 percent, leaves most of the walkable hall visible. It has a fine drag header and ONE close X. Show rows "人数上限" with "8", "投票门槛" with "70%", "特殊模式" with "关闭"; subsection "初始机体" with three small icon choices "侦察", "秘法", "战士". Warrior choice selected, icon simple sword-and-shield; scout icon bow, mage icon wand. These are mech presets, no big portraits. Bottom actions are small icon-only save disk and cancel cross.
A separate small mouse-following READ-ONLY tooltip near the settings console has ONLY a bold name "房间设置", one sentence "调整人数、投票与开局选项", and a tiny Shift badge to indicate the shown description. Mouse cursor adjacent. This tooltip has absolutely no title bar, X, buttons or drag affordance; it is visually lighter than the normal window.
Small helper at bottom "走近装置后按 G 交互".
Constraints: this is one coherent in-game screen. Main menu buttons must not appear. Keep only one avatar. No fabricated currencies, quests, battle pass, mandatory ready checks, chat, social lists or shop. Chinese text crisp and correct. Six stations are physical devices, not menu cards. No Western fantasy, ruins, gothic arches, gold ornament, runes or magic portals; also no spaceship or cyberpunk holograms. Avoid clutter.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: battle HUD art direction concept, one finished 16:9 desktop game screen.
Input images: Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the restrained modern workshop/base scene, flat graphite translucent UI, muted teal selection, crisp white Chinese sans-serif and simple square glyph controls. Do not reproduce the hall or its settings window.
Primary request: HSMultiplayer cooperative 2D adventure combat HUD in minimalist near-modern style, clean practical interface over a full-screen playable scene. This is a game UI concept, not character art. UI should read clearly at actual desktop scale.
World: elevated diagonal 2D game camera over a stylized practical concrete industrial training/battle area. Its ONE battle room footprint is visibly formed from THREE CONNECTED LARGE HEXAGONAL MODULES, an irregular branching outline, fully open floor joins, a roomy central cell and smaller left/right extensions. The floor has a subtle smaller hexagonal grid. A few plain steel crates, short barriers and ordinary doors at angled exterior walls, soft overcast light. Four small hostile practice drones/creatures and two modest avatars, one controlled player clearly visible near center firing a small projectile; keep figures secondary. Some scenery continues beyond openings to suggest connected world. No giant hero portrait. No medieval ruins, magical glowing portal, gothic decor or spaceship.
HUD EXACT layout:
UPPER LEFT: four compact square skill icons in one horizontal row, simple white glyphs, key badges "Q" "E" "R" "F". First shield glyph, second fast-step glyph, third burst glyph, fourth heal glyph; one has cooldown "3.2". Immediately below, four compact consumable icons with "1" "2" "3" "4" key badges, small count "12" on first. Minimal silhouettes of vial, supply pack, syringe, utility canister. No written names on these buttons.
Under those two rows: a small coin glyph followed by "248"; near it "等级 3" plus thin XP progress line. Do not scatter currencies elsewhere.
UPPER RIGHT: small minimap inside a quiet flat dark panel. MAP IS MADE OF DISTINCT CONNECTED HEXAGON CELLS and thin routes, some grouped adjacent hexes form irregular rooms, not rectangular corridors or square map tiles. Bottom-left INSIDE minimap contains "个人 4 · 共享 3". Below map a small camera icon control with "Tab". Beneath that two slim teammate rows with health bars: first "队友 A" and small "同房间" with special teal border; second "队友 B" and "其他房间" muted. They are teammates, no character portrait cards.
TOP CENTER: small quiet plaque "第 1/3 层" and "波次 2/3".
BOTTOM CENTER: a readable long thin health bar in restrained red with "132.00 / 150.00", below it a thin special resource bar in muted violet with "73 / 100". Exactly TWO dodge charge dots immediately to the RIGHT of health bar, one filled and one hollow.
Immediately ABOVE the health bar: THREE small status icons. First shows "2 · 8s", second "1 · 12s". Third shield status has ONLY "6s", NO level, NO stack number. Statuses use whole-effect level, not individual stack levels. No permanent full names.
BOTTOM RIGHT: three discrete square icon-only buttons for equipped weapon (simple sword), armor (vest) and backpack (bag), bag has "B" badge.
BOTTOM LEFT: small gear with "Esc".
Read-only tooltip near a mouse cursor hovering the first status, just above and to the left of lower center with enough open space. Compact charcoal box with precise clean typesetting and generous line spacing:
"迅捷"
"层数 2"
"剩余 8.0 秒"
"移动速度 +20%"
fine separator
small "Shift"
"基础 170 × (1 + 20%) = 204"
Use teal on movement-related keywords and numeric modifier, ivory for main text, gray labels. This is Shift-expanded information. Tooltip MUST have no X, title bar, drag handle, buttons, tabs, confirmation or cancel action. No other normal windows open.
Styling: flat quiet translucent graphite rectangles, modest corner radius, thin functional lines, consistent icon weight, small teal selection marks. UI panels have no medieval ornamental borders. Scene fills the entire screen behind HUD. Most buttons show only glyph plus shortcut; the tooltip carries descriptions. Ample edge safe margins. Chinese characters accurate and crisp. ONE coherent screenshot, no collage, no external annotations, no browser.
Avoid: dashboard sidebars, quest log, shop, chat, logos, invented extra resources, giant character illustration, Western fantasy, steampunk, gold ornament, glowing runes, holographic neon, heavy frames, tooltip close buttons.
